title: 人物帧图：主要角色与状态变体的三视图和动作条

subject.zh: 光之女神的模样：高挑的女子，白金长发一丝不乱垂到腰，白金色眼睛，目光像在测量尺寸。白与金的长袍左右绝对对称，领口与袖口镶几何纹金边，白 #f4f2ea、金 #d8b860，背后悬着精密的几何纹光环，像缓慢转动的齿轮。神情端正而冷淡。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of light as a tall woman: immaculate platinum hair falling straight to the waist, platinum eyes with a measuring gaze. Perfectly symmetrical white and gold robes with geometric gold trim at collar and cuffs, white #f4f2ea, gold #d8b860, a precise geometric halo floating behind her like slowly turning gears. Composed, cool expression. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 4 格胸像要画清白金色的眼睛、对称的衣领纹样与光环的几何纹。
extra.en: The bust in panel 4 must show the platinum eyes, the symmetrical collar pattern and the geometric halo.

items.notes: 参照图：主审通过后，作为本角色全部动作条、头像与半身立绘的参照；四格的发型、配色与标志物必须完全一致，记下通过图的种子。 光环是几何纹的齿轮状，不是圆形光圈；衣饰必须左右对称。

subject.zh: 争斗女神的模样：高大健硕的女战士，古铜肤色上满是旧伤疤，暗红蓬乱长发，金红色眼睛，笑起来露出尖牙。头上一对弯角，右角断了半截。红黑战甲 #8a1c1c、#1e1a1a，肩甲满是刀痕，肩上扛着一把断剑。豪爽好斗。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of strife as a towering, muscular woman warrior: bronze skin covered in old scars, wild dark red long hair, red-gold eyes, a fanged grin. A pair of curved horns, the right one broken halfway. Red and black battle armor #8a1c1c, #1e1a1a, pauldrons covered in blade nicks, a broken sword resting on her shoulder. Boisterous and eager for a fight. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

Boisterous and eager for a fight. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 交易女神的模样：半身人般的小个子女人，只到常人胸口，圆脸，脸颊几点雀斑，蜂蜜金卷发扎两个小发髻，金色眼睛笑得弯弯。多口袋的朱红商人外套镶金边 #b8402a、#e0b040，腋下夹一本厚账本，手里捏着一块点心，身边浮着几枚旋转的金币。Q 版约 1.6 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of trade as a halfling-sized woman who reaches an adult's chest: round face with a few freckles, honey-gold curls in two small buns, golden eyes curved in a smile. A vermilion merchant coat full of pockets with gold trim #b8402a, #e0b040, a thick ledger under one arm, a pastry in her hand, a few gold coins spinning in the air around her. Chibi about 1.6 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

items.notes: 参照图：主审通过后，作为本角色全部动作条、头像与半身立绘的参照；四格的发型、配色与标志物必须完全一致，记下通过图的种子。 金币是浮在她身边的几枚小圆片，属于角色本身，不是背景粒子；个子明显比常人矮。

subject.zh: 生命女神的模样：纤瘦轻盈的女子，苍白肤色，苍绿长发长及膝盖，发间同时插着枯花与新开的花，常闭着眼，神情安静。苔绿与枯叶褐的层叠薄衣像落叶 #6a8a5a、#8a6a42，赤足。动作又轻又慢。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of life as a slender, weightless woman: pale skin, knee-length pale green hair woven with both withered and freshly opened flowers, eyes usually closed, a quiet expression. subject.zh: 梦里站在门口的女人：高挑的成年女子，深褐长发松松垂到腰，脸的右半边总隐在阴影里，露出的左半边带着温柔的笑，眼睛是暖琥珀色。深夜蓝的及地长袍 #262c48，衣缘一道暖金细边 #f0d890，腰间一圈挂满大小不一的旧钥匙。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The woman who stands in a doorway in dreams: a tall grown woman, dark brown hair loose to the waist, the right half of her face always lost in shadow, the visible left half wearing a gentle smile, warm amber eyes. Floor-length midnight blue robe #262c48 edged with a thin warm gold line #f0d890, a ring of old keys of every size hanging at her waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 外表十五六岁的娇小少女，黑发及肩，发梢化成细羽，左鬓一缕白发，左眼琥珀色，右眼黑色。破旧深灰信使斗篷 #3a3a42 收拢时像一对合起的翅膀，胸前别钥孔形铜别针，腰挂封着暗红火漆 #8a2a2a 的皮信囊，长靴尖包爪形铁片。神情刻薄倔强。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A petite girl who looks fifteen or sixteen: shoulder-length black hair whose tips turn into fine feathers, one white lock at her left temple, left eye amber and right eye black. A worn dark grey messenger cloak #3a3a42 that looks like folded wings when closed, a keyhole-shaped copper pin on the chest, a leather letter pouch sealed with dark red wax #8a2a2a at her waist, long boots with claw-shaped iron toecaps. Sharp-tongued and stubborn. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 第 4 格胸像里右眼的瞳孔是细长的钥孔形；左鬓的白发在人物自己的左侧。
extra.en: In the panel 4 bust the right pupil is a slender keyhole shape; the white lock is on the character's own left side.

subject.zh: 十七岁的狼族兽人少女，浅相：人脸，银灰狼耳与狼尾。精瘦，中等偏高。银灰短发略乱，一侧编细辫挂狼牙与小铜铃，浅金色眼睛。森绿皮质猎装 #3f5a3a 配短披风与皮护臂 #8a6a4a，裸露的小臂有部族纹身，背长弓，腰挂猎刀与狼尾毛饰。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A seventeen-year-old wolf beastfolk girl in light aspect: human face with silver-grey wolf ears and tail. Lean, a little taller than average. Messy short silver-grey hair with one thin braid hung with a wolf fang and a small copper bell, pale gold eyes. Forest green leather hunting gear #3f5a3a with a short cape and leather bracers #8a6a4a, tribal tattoos on her bare forearms, a longbow on her back, a hunting knife and a wolf-tail charm at her belt. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 二十四岁的人族青年，中等身材偏瘦长，习惯缩着肩。棕色乱发，满脸雀斑，褐色眼睛，神情紧张又可靠。不太合身的二手皮甲 #6a5a44，脖子上一条褪色的蓝毛线围巾 #5a7a9a，左臂缠满五色护符，左手一面坑坑洼洼的旧铁圆盾，腰挂铜牌与短剑。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-four-year-old human young man, medium build on the lanky side, shoulders habitually hunched. Messy brown hair, a face full of freckles, brown eyes, nervous yet dependable. Ill-fitting second-hand leather armor #6a5a44, a faded blue knitted scarf #5a7a9a around his neck, his left arm wrapped in charms of five colors, a dented old iron round shield on his left arm, a copper tag and a short sword at his belt. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.en: A twenty-four-year-old human young man, medium build on the lanky side, shoulders habitually hunched. Messy brown hair, a face full of freckles, brown eyes, nervous yet dependable. Ill-fitting second-hand leather armor #6a5a44, a faded blue knitted scarf #5a7a9a around his neck, his left arm wrapped in charms of five colors, a dented old iron round shield on his left arm, a copper tag and a short sword at his belt. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 二十七岁、看着更年轻的狐族兽人女子，浅相：赤狐耳，蓬松大尾，尾尖白。身形纤细。橙红长发松松挽起，琥珀色狐狸眼笑眯眯。墨绿商人外套配金扣 #2e4a3a、#c8a24a，腰间一串算珠形计数珠，指间翻转着一枚旧金币，算账时戴半月形眼镜。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A fox beastfolk woman of twenty-seven who looks younger, light aspect: red fox ears and a big fluffy tail with a white tip. Slender. Orange-red long hair loosely pinned up, smiling amber fox eyes. Dark green merchant coat with gold buttons #2e4a3a, #c8a24a, a string of abacus-bead counters at her waist, a worn gold coin flipping between her fingers, half-moon spectacles for bookkeeping. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 七十一岁的人族老婆婆，瘦小，背微驼，满脸皱纹，灰绿眼睛眼神锐利。乱蓬蓬的白发用草绳束起。粗布裙 #5a4a3a 配打满补丁的苔绿围裙 #3a5a3a，口袋里塞满草药，脚踩木屐。拄一根藤杖，杖头住着一窝麻雀。慈和而固执。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A seventy-one-year-old human granny, small and thin, slightly stooped, deeply wrinkled, sharp grey-green eyes. Unruly white hair tied with straw cord. Coarse cloth skirt #5a4a3a with a heavily patched moss green apron #3a5a3a, pockets stuffed with herbs, wooden clogs. She leans on a vine staff with a nest of sparrows living at its head. Kind but obstinate. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 四十九岁的人族女人，高大结实，小臂粗壮带烫伤疤。深红短发夹着白丝，左颊一道旧刀疤，笑起来很爽朗，深褐眼睛。袖子挽起，酒红衬衫 #8a3a2a 外是旧皮甲改的束腰与深棕围裙 #5a3a2a，手里拿着酒杯与擦布，围裙下藏一把宽刃长刀。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A forty-nine-year-old human woman, tall and sturdy with thick, burn-scarred forearms. Short dark red hair streaked with white, an old blade scar on her left cheek, a hearty laugh, dark brown eyes. Sleeves rolled up, wine red shirt #8a3a2a under a bodice cut from old leather armor and a dark brown apron #5a3a2a, a tankard and polishing cloth in hand, a broad-bladed long sword hidden under the apron. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 四十六岁却像六十岁的人族老汉，粗壮，秃顶，灰色络腮胡，酒糟鼻，眯缝的灰眼睛。褪色的公会蓝旧制服 #4a5a7a，纽扣扣错一颗，右臂只剩空袖子别在肩上。左臂夹一本厚得夸张的登记簿，腰挂酒壶 #7a5a3a。粗声粗气。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A human man of forty-six who looks sixty: burly, bald, a grey full beard, a drinker's red nose, squinting grey eyes. A faded guild-blue old uniform #4a5a7a buttoned one hole off, the empty right sleeve pinned to his shoulder. An absurdly thick register clamped under his left arm, a flask #7a5a3a at his belt. Gruff and loud. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 骸骨守门人：人形骨架，眼眶里两点灰蓝冷火。披一件褪成灰白的古朴亚麻长袍 #c8c4b8，额骨上嵌一枚铜绿色的门形铜饰 #5a8a7a，指骨间夹一支芦苇笔，身上落着灰。炭黑、冷蓝、铜绿。安静而压迫。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A skeletal gatekeeper: a human skeleton with two points of cold grey-blue fire in its eye sockets. An antique linen robe faded to ash white #c8c4b8, a verdigris door-shaped copper ornament #5a8a7a set into the brow bone, a reed pen held between finger bones, ash settled on him. Charcoal, cold blue, verdigris. Quiet and oppressive. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 三十九岁的人族匪首，粗壮精悍，晒黑的方脸，右眼戴黑皮眼罩，左眼是凶狠的灰褐色，下巴满是胡茬，深棕短发剃得很短。锈褐色钉甲 #6a4a32 外披破旧灰斗篷 #5a5a52，腰缠粗皮带，右手一把单手劈斧，斧背沾着灰。狠，但讲规矩。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-nine-year-old human bandit chief, thickset and hard: a sunburnt square face, a black leather patch over his right eye, a fierce grey-brown left eye, heavy stubble, dark brown hair cropped short. Rust-brown studded brigandine #6a4a32 under a ragged grey cloak #5a5a52, a thick leather belt, a one-handed cleaver axe in his right hand, ash on its back edge. Ruthless but bound by his own rules. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 四十四岁的人族代官，中年发福，圆脸油亮，两撇修过的小胡子，黑发抹油梳得服帖，小而精的黑眼睛。紫红丝绒外套 #5a2a4a 镶金边 #c8a84a，胸前一条粗金链，手指戴印戒，捏着一块手帕。圆滑胆小又要体面。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A forty-four-year-old human magistrate, gone soft in middle age: a round shiny face, a neatly trimmed little moustache, oiled black hair combed flat, small sharp black eyes. A plum velvet coat #5a2a4a with gold trim #c8a84a, a heavy gold chain on his chest, signet rings, a handkerchief pinched in his fingers. Slippery and timid but keen on appearances. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.en: A twenty-four-year-old human scholar, tall, thin and slightly stooped. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 外表七十来岁的人族老船夫，瘦而精悍，晒成皮革色的皮肤，白发扎成短马尾，浅灰绿眼睛，眼角纹路深。褪色的蓝布衣 #4a6a8a，宽檐草帽 #c8b070，腰挂酒葫芦，腰后用油布裹着一把普通铁剑，手持一根长篙。神情懒散。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A human ferryman who looks about seventy, lean and wiry: skin tanned like leather, white hair in a short ponytail, pale grey-green eyes with deep crow's feet. Faded blue cloth clothes #4a6a8a, a wide-brimmed straw hat #c8b070, a gourd flask at his belt, a plain iron sword wrapped in oilcloth at the small of his back, a long punting pole in hand. Easygoing and lazy-looking. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 修长消瘦的人形，裹在层层黑灰旧斗篷里 #2a2a2e，斗篷下摆像墨一样往下滴着暗紫的澱 #4a3a62。脸是一片光滑空白的平面，像没写字的纸，正中一道细细的门形裂缝，透出暗紫微光。双手缠着灰白绷带，腰间挂一串拓着门形纹的纸片。Q 版约 1.7 头身。
subject.en: A tall, gaunt human figure wrapped in layers of old charcoal cloaks #2a2a2e, the hem dripping dark purple sediment like ink #4a3a62. The face is a smooth blank plane like an unwritten page, with a thin door-shaped crack down the middle leaking a dim purple glow. Hands wrapped in grey-white bandages, a string of paper rubbings of door shapes at the waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall.

extra.zh: 第 4 格胸像同样画出那张空白的脸与门形裂缝，不画任何五官。
extra.en: The panel 4 bust also shows the blank face with the door-shaped crack and no features at all.

subject.zh: 三十岁的人族贵族长子，身形端正，一丝不苟的金棕短发，浅褐眼睛，神情严肃。白底金纹的贵族礼服 #f0f0e8、#c8a040，外披短斗篷，胸前的圣徽比别人大一号，腰佩长剑，戴洁白手套。站姿笔挺，守礼而刻板。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-year-old human noble heir with an upright bearing, meticulously combed golden-brown short hair, light brown eyes, a stern face. A white noble's coat with gold patterns #f0f0e8, #c8a040, a short cape, a holy symbol on his chest one size larger than anyone else's, a longsword at his hip, spotless white gloves. Rigidly proper. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 三十岁的人族贵族长子，身形端正，一丝不苟的金棕短发，浅褐眼睛，神情严肃。白底金纹的贵族礼服 #f0f0e8、#c8a040，外披短斗篷，胸前的圣徽比别人大一号，腰佩长剑，戴洁白手套。站姿笔挺，守礼而刻板。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-year-old human noble heir with an upright bearing, meticulously combed golden-brown short hair, light brown eyes, a stern face. A white noble's coat with gold patterns #f0f0e8, #c8a040, a short cape, a holy symbol on his chest one size larger than anyone else's, a longsword at his hip, spotless white gloves. Rigidly proper. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 骑乘时背挺得笔直，长剑挂在腰侧。
extra.en: Riding posture with a ramrod-straight back, longsword at his hip.

subject.zh: 四十出头的人族男子，瘦削，颧骨突出，下巴尖，深陷的灰眼睛里有求知的狂热。黑发夹白，向后束成短辫。灰黑学者长外套 #2e2e36，领口别一枚磨损的旧徽章，指尖有灼伤的暗痕，手里把玩一枚淡青色的录晶 #8ac8c8。冷淡而专注。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A human man in his early forties, gaunt, with sharp cheekbones and a pointed chin, deep-set grey eyes burning with hunger for knowledge. Black hair streaked with white, tied back in a short tail. A charcoal scholar's long coat #2e2e36, a worn old badge at the collar, dark burn marks on his fingertips, turning a pale cyan recording crystal #8ac8c8 in his fingers. Cool and focused. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 七十四岁的人族老王，枯瘦，久病，长长的白须，深陷的眼窝里是清醒的灰蓝眼睛。褪色的王室蓝睡袍外披象牙白毛皮边斗篷 #3a4a7a、#e8e0cc，头上一圈素金细冠。气若游丝，却仍有骑士的气度。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A seventy-four-year-old human king, emaciated and long ill: a long white beard, clear grey-blue eyes in sunken sockets. A faded royal blue nightrobe under an ivory fur-trimmed mantle #3a4a7a, #e8e0cc, a thin plain gold circlet. Barely breathing, yet still carrying himself like a knight. subject.zh: 二十八岁的人族王太子，清秀单薄，浅亚麻色软发，浅灰蓝眼睛，神情犹豫，总在咬指甲。衣着整洁却不合身，像借来的：浅蓝外套 #8aa8c8 袖子太长，银色纽扣与肩饰 #c0c4cc，胸前一枚小小的王室纹章。软弱而善良。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-eight-year-old human crown prince, delicate and slight: soft flaxen hair, pale grey-blue eyes, a hesitant expression, always biting his nails. Neat clothes that do not fit, as if borrowed: a pale blue coat #8aa8c8 with sleeves too long, silver buttons and epaulettes #c0c4cc, a small royal crest on his chest. Weak-willed but kind. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

Black and red light armor #1e1a1a, #8a1c22, no helmet, boxing wraps on both hands under a pair of iron fist gauntlets #6a6a70. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

Black and red light armor #1e1a1a, #8a1c22, no helmet, boxing wraps on both hands under a pair of iron fist gauntlets #6a6a70. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 年过半百的人族大审判长，高大清瘦，脸颊凹陷，铁灰头发剪得极短，浅灰眼睛冷而平静。灰色审判长外袍 #6a6a6e 罩在白银板甲上，肩披灰色短披肩，胸前天平徽章，腰挂一柄带翼缘的钉头锤 #8a8a90。冷酷而高效。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A human grand inquisitor past fifty, tall and gaunt with hollow cheeks, iron-grey hair cropped very short, cold and calm pale grey eyes. A grey inquisitor's surcoat #6a6a6e over silver plate, a short grey capelet, a scales badge on the chest, a flanged mace #8a8a90 at his belt. Cold and efficient. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 年过半百的人族大审判长，高大清瘦，脸颊凹陷，铁灰头发剪得极短，浅灰眼睛冷而平静。灰色审判长外袍 #6a6a6e 罩在白银板甲上，肩披灰色短披肩，胸前天平徽章，腰挂一柄带翼缘的钉头锤 #8a8a90。冷酷而高效。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。

subject.en: A forty-five-year-old human magnate, medium height and a little plump: dark hair combed immaculately with grey temples, dark brown eyes behind gold-rimmed glasses, a shrewd smile. A charcoal three-piece suit #3a3a3e with a wine red tie #7a1e2a, a pocket watch chain at the vest, a tiny gold crown #d8b040 perched askew on his head, twirling a fountain pen. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.en: A fifty-eight-year-old human emperor, tall and massive: iron-grey short hair and short beard, steady grey eyes, the left little finger missing its upper half. Plain black iron battle armor #2e2e30 with silver rivets under an imperial purple cape #5a2a6a, a completely unadorned longsword at his hip with the imperial crown hung carelessly on its hilt. Chibi about 1.8 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 外表三十来岁的夜魔女子，修长，灰蓝苍白肤色，黑色眼白配新月形银色瞳孔，额上一对后弯细角，长及脚踝的黑发像夜色般微微漂浮。深紫与黑的宫廷长裙 #3a2048、#141218，肩披星点刺绣薄纱，手持银色摄政权杖，腰挂皮绳缠住的旧手记。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A night demon woman who looks about thirty, tall and slender: pale grey-blue skin, black sclera with crescent-shaped silver pupils, a pair of thin horns curving back from her forehead, ankle-length black hair drifting like flowing night. A deep purple and black court gown #3a2048, #141218, a sheer star-embroidered veil over her shoulders, a silver regent's scepter in hand, an old journal bound with leather cord at her waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

A grey-green elder's robe #7a8a72, an ancient dark bronze door-shaped earring in his left ear, a white wooden staff sprouting new shoots. Chibi about 1.8 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 鬼人大诸侯，比常人高出一头多，肌肉夸张，赭红色厚皮，额上两支粗黑角，左角上刻着一道道胜痕，下颌短獠牙，黄褐眼睛凶悍。泛着红锈的夜铁重甲 #2a2a2e、#8a3a22，肩甲宽大，披黑熊皮，双手握一柄赤铁大斧。傲慢好战。Q 版约 1.8 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: An oni demon high lord, a head and more taller than an ordinary man, exaggerated muscles: thick ochre-red hide, two heavy black horns on his brow with notches of victory cut into the left one, short tusks in his lower jaw, fierce yellow-brown eyes. Night-iron heavy armor with red rust #2a2a2e, #8a3a22, huge pauldrons, a black bear pelt, a red iron great axe gripped in both hands. Arrogant and warlike. Chibi about 1.8 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

Chibi about 1.8 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 专属小动作：把赤铁大斧往地上一顿，仰头狂笑。
extra.en: Signature move: Slams the red iron great axe onto the ground and roars with laughter.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 高大体型：帧内本体约 33 到 35 像素，比标准人形高；角上的胜痕只是刻痕，不是文字。

subject.zh: 一只小乌鸦，比家鸽略小，羽毛墨黑、羽尖带灰白，左侧头顶一撮白羽，左眼琥珀色，右眼黑色。爪上套着细小的爪形铁片，脖子上系一枚钥孔形小铜饰。动作快而突然，常歪着头。
subject.en: A small crow, a little smaller than a pigeon: ink-black feathers with ash-white tips, a tuft of white feathers on the left side of its head, left eye amber and right eye black. Tiny claw-shaped iron caps on its talons, a little keyhole-shaped copper charm tied at its neck. Quick, sudden movements, often tilting its head.

extra.zh: 第 4 格是头部特写：左眼琥珀、右眼黑，右眼瞳孔是细长的钥孔形，左侧头顶的一撮白羽。
extra.en: Panel 4 is a head close-up: left eye amber, right eye black with a slender keyhole-shaped pupil, the white tuft on the left side of the head.

subject.zh: 十九岁的少年剑士，精瘦，黑色短发凌乱，额前一缕翘发，黑眼睛疲惫却清醒。卸下了红披风，白金铠甲满是划痕与灰尘 #c8c8cc，胸甲的光环纹磨暗了，深蓝内衬 #2a3a6a 露在外面，握一把普通钢剑，左手腕仍戴着没电的黑色运动手环。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A nineteen-year-old young swordsman, lean, short black hair in disarray with one cowlick, tired but clear black eyes. The red cape is gone; his white-gold armor is scratched and dusty #c8c8cc, the halo pattern on the breastplate worn dull, the deep blue lining #2a3a6a showing, a plain steel sword in hand, the dead black fitness band still on his left wrist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 十七岁的少女圣女被光托起的模样：娇小，黑色长直发与齐刘海被光吹起，白缎带飘散，眼睛变成白金色、没有焦点。纯白圣女长袍 #f4f4f8 镶天蓝边，胸前挂护士表，背后浮着缓慢转动的几何纹光环 #e8dca0，双脚离地。神情空白。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A seventeen-year-old girl saint lifted by light: petite, her long straight black hair and blunt bangs blown upward, the white ribbon streaming loose, her eyes turned white-gold and unfocused. Pure white saint's robe #f4f4f8 with sky blue edging, the nurse's watch on her chest, a slowly turning geometric halo #e8dca0 floating behind her, feet off the ground. A blank expression. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.en: A seventeen-year-old girl saint lifted by light: petite, her long straight black hair and blunt bangs blown upward, the white ribbon streaming loose, her eyes turned white-gold and unfocused. Pure white saint's robe #f4f4f8 with sky blue edging, the nurse's watch on her chest, a slowly turning geometric halo #e8dca0 floating behind her, feet off the ground. A blank expression. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 受击时身体在空中一晃，光环出现缺口般的抖动。
extra.en: When hit her body jolts in midair and the halo shudders.

subject.zh: 在现实里现身的高挑女人：深褐长发，左半张脸带着温柔的笑，暖琥珀色眼睛，右半边身体化作一道暖金色的门框 #f0d890，门框里是幽暗的空。深夜蓝长袍 #262c48 只裹住另一半身体，腰间挂满大小不一的旧钥匙。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A tall woman appearing in the waking world: dark brown hair, the left half of her face smiling gently with a warm amber eye, the right half of her body turned into a warm gold door frame #f0d890 with dim emptiness inside it. A midnight blue robe #262c48 wraps only the other half of her body, old keys of every size hanging at her waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

subject.zh: 末班车上的中年醉汉：微胖，脸颊喝得发红，稀疏的头发乱翘，下巴一层胡茬，眼皮耷拉着。皱巴巴的深灰西装外套 #3a3c42 裹得很紧，暗红领带 #7a2a2a 松垮地歪在一边，白衬衫领口敞开，脚上一双磨旧的黑皮鞋。Q 版约 1.7 头身。
subject.en: A middle-aged drunk on the last train: a little heavy, cheeks flushed from drink, thin hair sticking up, stubble on his chin, drooping eyelids. A rumpled dark grey suit jacket #3a3c42 wrapped tight, a dark red tie #7a2a2a hanging loose and crooked, the white shirt collar open, a pair of worn black leather shoes. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall.

extra.zh: 第 4 格画正常比例的胸像：发红的脸、胡茬与歪掉的领带。
extra.en: Panel 4 is a normal-proportion bust: the flushed face, the stubble and the crooked tie.

extra.zh: 过场专属动作：第 1、2 帧靠着车窗睡着，悬空坐姿（座椅与车窗不画），头歪向一侧，随呼吸轻轻起伏；第 3、4 帧在睡梦里翻身，把外套裹得更紧，头歪到另一侧。
extra.en: Cutscene action: frames 1 and 2 he sleeps against the train window in a seated pose in the air (no seat or window drawn), head tilted to one side, rising and falling with his breath; frames 3 and 4 he turns over in his sleep, pulls the jacket tighter and lets his head drop to the other side.

subject.zh: 便利店的年轻店员：二十出头，瘦，黑色短发有点乱，眼皮发沉，一脸困意。蓝白两色的店员制服背心 #3a6ab0、#f0f0f0 套在白色长袖衫外，胸前别一块空白名牌，袖口挽到小臂。Q 版约 1.7 头身。
subject.en: A young convenience store clerk: early twenties, thin, short black hair a little messy, heavy eyelids, visibly sleepy. A blue and white staff vest #3a6ab0, #f0f0f0 over a white long-sleeved shirt, a blank name tag on the chest, sleeves pushed up to the forearms. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall.

extra.zh: 第 4 格画正常比例的胸像：困倦的眼睛与胸前的空白名牌。
extra.en: Panel 4 is a normal-proportion bust: the sleepy eyes and the blank name tag.

subject.zh: 夜班护士：二十多岁的女子，黑发在脑后盘成低髻，脸色疲惫但步子很快。浅蓝色护士服 #a8c8e0 外披一件深蓝针织开衫 #2a3a5a，白色软底鞋，胸前口袋插着一支笔，挂着一块空白工牌。Q 版约 1.7 头身。
subject.en: A night-shift nurse: a woman in her twenties, black hair in a low bun, a tired face but a quick step. A light blue nurse uniform #a8c8e0 under a dark blue knit cardigan #2a3a5a, white soft-soled shoes, a pen in the breast pocket and a blank ID badge. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall.

extra.zh: 第 4 格画正常比例的胸像：盘起的低髻、开衫与空白工牌。
extra.en: Panel 4 is a normal-proportion bust: the low bun, the cardigan and the blank badge.

subject.zh: 屋檐下躲雨的小猫：普通的短毛家猫，个子小而瘦，橘白相间 #d88a3a、#f2ece0，背上的毛被雨打湿了一半，一绺一绺贴在身上，细长的尾巴绕在前脚边，圆眼睛是琥珀色 #d8a040。
subject.en: A small cat sheltering from the rain under the eaves: an ordinary short-haired house cat, small and thin, orange and white #d88a3a, #f2ece0, the fur on its back half soaked and clinging in wet clumps, its long thin tail wrapped around its front paws, round amber eyes #d8a040.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写湿了一半的背毛与圆眼睛。
extra.en: Panel 4 is a close-up of the half-soaked back fur and the round eyes.

extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces the viewer (down). Row 1 holds 4 idle frames in order: sitting, ears pricked, looking back over its shoulder, a small open-mouthed mew; row 2 is a 6-frame trot away; rows 3 and 4 stay empty in the background color.

subject.zh: 光之女神的模样：高挑的女子，白金长发一丝不乱垂到腰，白金色眼睛，目光像在测量尺寸。白与金的长袍左右绝对对称，领口与袖口镶几何纹金边，白 #f4f2ea、金 #d8b860，背后悬着精密的几何纹光环，像缓慢转动的齿轮。神情端正而冷淡。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of light as a tall woman: immaculate platinum hair falling straight to the waist, platinum eyes with a measuring gaze. Perfectly symmetrical white and gold robes with geometric gold trim at collar and cuffs, white #f4f2ea, gold #d8b860, a precise geometric halo floating behind her like slowly turning gears. Composed, cool expression. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 过场专属动作，按顺序播放一次，不必接回第 1 帧：第 1 帧从座位上站起（座椅不画），第 2 帧右手抬到胸前，第 3 帧手臂向前伸直、食指指向前方，第 4 帧指尖落下一点白金色的光。
extra.en: Cutscene action, played once in order, with no need to loop back to frame 1: frame 1 she rises from her seat (no chair drawn), frame 2 her right hand lifts to her chest, frame 3 the arm extends straight forward with the index finger pointing ahead, frame 4 a single point of platinum light drops from her fingertip.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_p_judgement。指尖只画一个小亮点，扫过人形的光由特效 art_vfx_cut_appraise_light 另画。 光环是几何纹的齿轮状，不是圆形光圈；衣饰必须左右对称。

subject.zh: 争斗女神的模样：高大健硕的女战士，古铜肤色上满是旧伤疤，暗红蓬乱长发，金红色眼睛，笑起来露出尖牙。头上一对弯角，右角断了半截。红黑战甲 #8a1c1c、#1e1a1a，肩甲满是刀痕，肩上扛着一把断剑。豪爽好斗。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of strife as a towering, muscular woman warrior: bronze skin covered in old scars, wild dark red long hair, red-gold eyes, a fanged grin. A pair of curved horns, the right one broken halfway. Red and black battle armor #8a1c1c, #1e1a1a, pauldrons covered in blade nicks, a broken sword resting on her shoulder. Boisterous and eager for a fight. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 过场专属动作，按顺序播放一次，不必接回第 1 帧：第 1 帧抬起右掌，第 2 帧一掌拍下（长桌不画，手掌停在腰的高度），第 3、4 帧仰头大笑，露出尖牙，断剑仍扛在肩上。
extra.en: Cutscene action, played once in order, with no need to loop back to frame 1: frame 1 she raises her right palm, frame 2 slams it down (no table drawn, the palm stops at waist height), frames 3 and 4 she throws her head back laughing with her fangs showing, the broken sword still on her shoulder.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_p_judgement。 断的是右角；断剑的剑身只剩一半。

subject.zh: 交易女神的模样：半身人般的小个子女人，只到常人胸口，圆脸，脸颊几点雀斑，蜂蜜金卷发扎两个小发髻，金色眼睛笑得弯弯。多口袋的朱红商人外套镶金边 #b8402a、#e0b040，腋下夹一本厚账本，手里捏着一块点心，身边浮着几枚旋转的金币。Q 版约 1.6 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of trade as a halfling-sized woman who reaches an adult's chest: round face with a few freckles, honey-gold curls in two small buns, golden eyes curved in a smile. A vermilion merchant coat full of pockets with gold trim #b8402a, #e0b040, a thick ledger under one arm, a pastry in her hand, a few gold coins spinning in the air around her. Chibi about 1.6 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 过场专属动作，按顺序播放一次，不必接回第 1 帧：第 1 帧坐在高处，悬空坐姿（高椅不画），第 2 帧双脚离开座位跳下，第 3 帧落地屈膝，第 4 帧站直，指间转着一枚金币。
extra.en: Cutscene action, played once in order, with no need to loop back to frame 1: frame 1 she sits up high in a seated pose in the air (no tall chair drawn), frame 2 she hops off with both feet, frame 3 she lands with knees bent, frame 4 she stands upright with a gold coin spinning between her fingers.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_p_judgement。 金币是浮在她身边的几枚小圆片，属于角色本身，不是背景粒子；个子明显比常人矮。

subject.zh: 记录女神的模样：身形修长的兜帽书记官，墨蓝兜帽长袍 #2a3450，兜帽下露出栗色短发与常带笑的嘴角，左眼前悬一片刻着细纹的圆镜片，指尖沾着墨。腰后拖着一条羊皮纸色长卷轴 #e8dcc0 一直垂到地上，身边浮着一本翻开的书。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of record as a tall hooded scribe: ink-blue hooded robe #2a3450, chestnut short hair and a ready smile under the hood, a round lens etched with fine lines hovering before her left eye, ink-stained fingertips. A parchment-colored scroll #e8dcc0 trails from her waist down to the ground, an open book floats beside her. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 过场专属动作，4 帧循环：低头伏案，用一支羽毛笔在卷轴上写字（长桌不画，执笔的手前伸到腰的高度）；第 1、2 帧笔尖移动，第 3 帧停笔，第 4 帧用左手推一下镜片。
extra.en: Cutscene action, a 4-frame loop: head bowed over a desk, writing on a scroll with a quill (no desk drawn, the pen hand reaching forward at waist height); frames 1 and 2 the nib moves, frame 3 she pauses, frame 4 she pushes the lens up with her left hand.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_p_call 与 cut_p_interview。 镜片在左眼前；书页与卷轴上一个字也没有，只有空白与淡淡的格线。

subject.zh: 标准体型人台（H）：成年人形的 Q 版身体，身高约 1.75 米，头约占身高的五成半，头最宽处略宽于肩，四肢匀称，手脚简化成圆头；全身中性灰 #8c8c8c，暗面 #6c6c6c，亮面 #acacac，肩、肘、膝有浅浅的分段线
subject.en: Standard body mannequin (H): an adult chibi body about 1.75 m tall, the head about 55 percent of the height and slightly wider than the shoulders, even limbs, hands and feet simplified to rounded ends; neutral gray #8c8c8c all over, shadow #6c6c6c, light #acacac, faint segment lines at the shoulders, elbows and knees

extra.zh: 主体是纸娃娃固定人台：中性灰色光头人台，没有头发、衣服细节与性别特征，双手半握。过场专属动作，4 帧循环：在黑暗里坠落或漂浮，身体微微后仰，四肢舒展张开，手脚随下坠的风轻轻摆动，四帧之间只有手脚角度的细小变化。
extra.en: The subject is the fixed paper-doll mannequin: a neutral gray bald mannequin with no hair, clothing detail or gender features, hands half closed. Cutscene action, a 4-frame loop: falling or floating in darkness, the body tilted slightly back, limbs spread wide, hands and feet drifting in the rushing air; the four frames differ only in small changes of limb angle.

items.notes: 附人台三视图 art_doll_mannequin_h_ref 作参照，每格头的大小一致，手半握；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头。 用于 cut_p_discard 的坠落。 这是纸娃娃人台的姿势基准，头部件按人台锚点叠加；地球服装层的同名姿势要在纸娃娃条目里另补；小型与高大体型按本条缩放。

subject.zh: 标准体型人台（H）：成年人形的 Q 版身体，身高约 1.75 米，头约占身高的五成半，头最宽处略宽于肩，四肢匀称，手脚简化成圆头；全身中性灰 #8c8c8c，暗面 #6c6c6c，亮面 #acacac，肩、肘、膝有浅浅的分段线
subject.en: Standard body mannequin (H): an adult chibi body about 1.75 m tall, the head about 55 percent of the height and slightly wider than the shoulders, even limbs, hands and feet simplified to rounded ends; neutral gray #8c8c8c all over, shadow #6c6c6c, light #acacac, faint segment lines at the shoulders, elbows and knees

extra.zh: 主体是纸娃娃固定人台：中性灰色光头人台，没有头发、衣服细节与性别特征，双手半握。过场专属动作，按顺序播放一次：坠落中向上伸出右手，第 1、2 帧手从身侧抬起，第 3、4 帧手臂伸到最高，五指张开。
extra.en: The subject is the fixed paper-doll mannequin: a neutral gray bald mannequin with no hair, clothing detail or gender features, hands half closed. Cutscene action, played once in order: while falling the right hand reaches upward; frames 1 and 2 the hand lifts from the side, frames 3 and 4 the arm stretches to its highest point with the fingers spread.

items.notes: 附人台三视图 art_doll_mannequin_h_ref 作参照，每格头的大小一致，手半握；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头。 用于 cut_p_discard 的坠落；目录要求 2 帧，本条每个姿势各画 2 帧。 这是纸娃娃人台的姿势基准，头部件按人台锚点叠加；地球服装层的同名姿势要在纸娃娃条目里另补；小型与高大体型按本条缩放。

subject.zh: 外表十五六岁的娇小少女，黑发及肩，发梢化成细羽，左鬓一缕白发，左眼琥珀色，右眼黑色。破旧深灰信使斗篷 #3a3a42 收拢时像一对合起的翅膀，胸前别钥孔形铜别针，腰挂封着暗红火漆 #8a2a2a 的皮信囊，长靴尖包爪形铁片。神情刻薄倔强。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A petite girl who looks fifteen or sixteen: shoulder-length black hair whose tips turn into fine feathers, one white lock at her left temple, left eye amber and right eye black. A worn dark grey messenger cloak #3a3a42 that looks like folded wings when closed, a keyhole-shaped copper pin on the chest, a leather letter pouch sealed with dark red wax #8a2a2a at her waist, long boots with claw-shaped iron toecaps. Sharp-tongued and stubborn. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 过场专属动作，按顺序播放一次，不必接回第 1 帧：第 1 帧是收拢双翼、伏在地上的焦黑巨鸦，羽毛上覆满灰（按守护巨鸦三视图缩到格内能容纳的大小）；第 2 帧黑灰从羽毛上大片剥落，露出银色的羽根；第 3 帧身形向内收拢，羽毛化成斗篷的轮廓；第 4 帧站起来的是披着斗篷的少女。
extra.en: Cutscene action, played once in order, with no need to loop back to frame 1: frame 1 is a scorched giant raven crouched on the ground with its wings folded, its feathers coated in ash (scaled down from the guardian raven turnaround to fit the cell); frame 2 the black ash peels off the feathers in sheets, revealing silver feather roots; frame 3 the shape draws inward and the feathers become the outline of a cloak; frame 4 the cloaked girl stands up.

items.notes: 附本人三视图与守护巨鸦三视图 art_boss_guardian_raven_ref 作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；第 4 帧的少女按本人固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a1_yeyu_bound（契约之门）。 左鬓白发与琥珀色左眼都在角色自己的左侧；左向镜像后若换边，由导入工具出头部修正件；信囊的暗红火漆是全身唯一的暖色。

subject.zh: 四十九岁的人族女人，高大结实，小臂粗壮带烫伤疤。深红短发夹着白丝，左颊一道旧刀疤，笑起来很爽朗，深褐眼睛。袖子挽起，酒红衬衫 #8a3a2a 外是旧皮甲改的束腰与深棕围裙 #5a3a2a，手里拿着酒杯与擦布，围裙下藏一把宽刃长刀。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A forty-nine-year-old human woman, tall and sturdy with thick, burn-scarred forearms. Short dark red hair streaked with white, an old blade scar on her left cheek, a hearty laugh, dark brown eyes. Sleeves rolled up, wine red shirt #8a3a2a under a bodice cut from old leather armor and a dark brown apron #5a3a2a, a tankard and polishing cloth in hand, a broad-bladed long sword hidden under the apron. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 过场专属的一刀：第 1 帧围裙一甩、压低身形，第 2 帧宽刃长刀已经出鞘、横斩而过（出手帧），第 3 帧刀势拉满停住，第 4 帧收刀，刀回到围裙下。
extra.en: The cutscene's single cut: frame 1 a flick of the apron as she drops low, frame 2 the broad-bladed long knife is already out and sweeps across (strike frame), frame 3 the stroke is held at full extension, frame 4 the knife returns beneath the apron.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a1_martha（一刀）与 cut_a3_ashen_line（镇门前一刀）。第一幕取前 3 帧；第三幕目录要求 1 向 6 帧，取本条 4 帧并让出手帧停留两拍，刀光与地上的刀痕由特效 art_vfx_cut_a1_martha_slash 另画。 刀疤在左颊；刀平时藏在围裙下，只在攻击、战斗待机与受击里出鞘。

subject.zh: 五十六岁的人族主教，高大微胖，面色红润，下巴圆厚，银灰短发梳得整齐，浅灰眼睛带着居高临下的和蔼。象牙白主教长袍 #f0e8d0 镶金色光环纹 #c8a84a，头戴低矮的白色主教冠，胸前挂一枚沉甸甸的金圣徽，手持主教杖。
subject.en: A fifty-six-year-old human bishop, tall and a little heavy, a ruddy face with a full round chin, neatly combed silver-grey short hair, pale grey eyes with condescending kindness. An ivory bishop's robe #f0e8d0 trimmed with gold halo patterns #c8a84a, a low white bishop's mitre, a heavy gold holy symbol on his chest, a crozier in hand.

extra.zh: 过场专属动作，按顺序播放一次，不必接回第 1 帧：第 1 帧站在台阶上，双手合在胸前（台阶不画），第 2 帧双臂缓缓向两侧展开，第 3 帧展开到最大、微微仰头，第 4 帧保持赐福的姿势；主教杖一直握在右手。
extra.en: Cutscene action, played once in order, with no need to loop back to frame 1: frame 1 he stands on the steps with his hands together at his chest (no steps drawn), frame 2 his arms slowly open to the sides, frame 3 they open fully as he lifts his face slightly, frame 4 he holds the pose of blessing; the crozier stays in his right hand throughout.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的三向放大图）作参照：他在场景里是纸娃娃组装的人物，没有三视图；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a2_heroes，过场只用第 1 行（面向镜头）。 主教冠与权杖顶端是几何光环图形，不用十字。

subject.zh: 外表七十来岁的人族老船夫，瘦而精悍，晒成皮革色的皮肤，白发扎成短马尾，浅灰绿眼睛，眼角纹路深。褪色的蓝布衣 #4a6a8a，宽檐草帽 #c8b070，腰挂酒葫芦，腰后用油布裹着一把普通铁剑，手持一根长篙。神情懒散。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A human ferryman who looks about seventy, lean and wiry: skin tanned like leather, white hair in a short ponytail, pale grey-green eyes with deep crow's feet. Faded blue cloth clothes #4a6a8a, a wide-brimmed straw hat #c8b070, a gourd flask at his belt, a plain iron sword wrapped in oilcloth at the small of his back, a long punting pole in hand. Easygoing and lazy-looking. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 本条不是施法，八帧按顺序是一段过场动作：第 1 帧坐在船头，悬空坐姿（船不画），第 2 帧起身站直，第 3 帧右手伸向腰后、解开裹剑的油布，第 4 帧抽出铁剑，第 5 帧双手举剑过肩，第 6 帧一刀向下劈落（劈落的瞬间），第 7 帧把剑收回油布里，第 8 帧坐回原处。
extra.en: This is not a spell: the eight frames form one continuous cutscene action in order: frame 1 he sits at the bow in a seated pose in the air (no boat drawn), frame 2 he rises and stands straight, frame 3 his right hand reaches behind his waist and unwraps the oilcloth around the sword, frame 4 he draws the iron sword, frame 5 he raises it over his shoulder with both hands, frame 6 a single downward cut (the moment of the strike), frame 7 the sword goes back into the oilcloth, frame 8 he sits back down.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a2_ferryman（劈开河面），过场取第 1、2 行（正面与侧面）；目录要求 12 帧，本条用八帧覆盖站起、抽剑、一刀、坐回，劈开的河面与刀光由特效 art_vfx_cut_ferryman_cut 另画。 草帽的宽檐要压得住剪影；铁剑平时裹在油布里挂在腰后，只在近战时露出。

subject.zh: 二十七岁的人族女审判官，修长挺拔。银白短发齐耳切平，灰色瞳孔，神情冷静。白银甲胄外罩纯白长披风 #eceef2，披风内衬绣细密的光环几何纹，左手戴刻满细纹的黑铁手套，腰佩细长刺剑，胸前天平徽章，挂一点朱红封蜡 #b8302a。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-seven-year-old human inquisitor, tall and poised. Silver-white hair cut straight at the ears, grey eyes, a calm expression. Silver plate under a long pure white cloak #eceef2 whose lining is embroidered with fine geometric halo patterns, a black iron gauntlet covered in fine engraving on her left hand, a slender rapier at her hip, a scales badge on her chest with a dab of vermilion sealing wax #b8302a. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 本条不是施法，八帧按顺序是一段过场动作：刺剑收在腰侧，第 1 到 4 帧双手把一面银边圆镜捧在胸前，身体微微起伏；第 5 帧把镜子举起，第 6 帧镜面对准正前方（对准的瞬间），第 7、8 帧保持举镜的姿势。镜面只画平整的银色与一圈银边，不画光效。
extra.en: This is not a spell: the eight frames form one continuous cutscene action in order: the rapier stays sheathed at her side; frames 1 to 4 she holds a silver-rimmed round mirror at her chest with both hands, body rising and falling slightly; frame 5 she lifts the mirror, frame 6 the mirror face aims straight ahead (the moment it is aimed), frames 7 and 8 she holds the raised mirror. Draw only a flat silver face and a silver rim, with no light effects.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a2_selene_trial（光之审），过场只用第 1 行（面向镜头）；目录要求 6 帧，本条按八帧画，镜面的光由特效另画。 铁手套在左手，刺剑在右手；手套上的纹路只是花纹，不是文字。

subject.zh: 修长消瘦的人形，裹在层层黑灰旧斗篷里 #2a2a2e，斗篷下摆像墨一样往下滴着暗紫的澱 #4a3a62。脸是一片光滑空白的平面，像没写字的纸，正中一道细细的门形裂缝，透出暗紫微光。双手缠着灰白绷带，腰间挂一串拓着门形纹的纸片。Q 版约 1.7 头身。
subject.en: A tall, gaunt human figure wrapped in layers of old charcoal cloaks #2a2a2e, the hem dripping dark purple sediment like ink #4a3a62. The face is a smooth blank plane like an unwritten page, with a thin door-shaped crack down the middle leaking a dim purple glow. Hands wrapped in grey-white bandages, a string of paper rubbings of door shapes at the waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall.

extra.zh: 本条不是施法，八帧按顺序是一段过场动作：第 1 到 4 帧静静站着，斗篷下摆往下滴澱，门形裂缝的光一明一灭；第 5 帧缓缓抬起缠着绷带的右手，第 6 帧手背翻向前方停在胸前（亮出手背的瞬间），第 7、8 帧保持抬手的姿势。
extra.en: This is not a spell: the eight frames form one continuous cutscene action in order: frames 1 to 4 he stands still, the cloak hem dripping sediment, the light in the door-shaped crack pulsing; frame 5 he slowly raises his bandaged right hand, frame 6 the back of the hand turns forward and stops at chest height (the moment the back of the hand is shown), frames 7 and 8 he holds the raised hand.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a2_funeral（投影）：过场由渲染层把本条压成半透明的黑色剪影，只保留门形裂缝的暗紫光，不另出投影图；手背上的反相门纹由渲染层按手部锚点画。目录要求南向 6 帧，本条按八帧画。 脸上绝对不画五官；手背的门纹由渲染层画，不进素材；对话框只显示空的头像框，头像与半身立绘只用于角色卡与过场演出；纸片上没有字。

subject.zh: 三十一岁的人族壮汉，高大魁梧，深棕皮肤，剃短的黑发，修剪整齐的胡子，笑起来一口白牙，深褐眼睛，左前臂有烧伤疤。白银重甲 #c8ccd4，腰间系一条褪色的亮橙反光带 #e8782a，左手持正面浮雕光环的塔盾，背包上挂一顶旧消防头盔。Q 版约 1.8 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-one-year-old human giant of a man, tall and broad: deep brown skin, buzzed black hair, a neatly trimmed beard, a bright white smile, dark brown eyes, a burn scar on his left forearm. Silver-white heavy plate #c8ccd4, a faded bright orange reflective band #e8782a tied at his waist, a tower shield embossed with a halo on his left arm, an old firefighter's helmet hanging from his pack. Chibi about 1.8 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 本条不是施法，八帧按顺序是一段过场动作：第 1 到 4 帧双手提起塔盾，向前跨两大步插到两队之间；第 5 帧把塔盾高高抬起，第 6 帧塔盾重重立在地上（落地的瞬间），第 7、8 帧压低重心，用肩顶住盾。
extra.en: This is not a spell: the eight frames form one continuous cutscene action in order: frames 1 to 4 he lifts the tower shield in both hands and takes two long strides forward between the two groups; frame 5 he heaves the shield high, frame 6 it slams down upright into the ground (the moment of impact), frames 7 and 8 he drops his weight and braces the shield with his shoulder.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a2_arrest（逮捕令），过场取第 1、2 行（正面与侧面）；目录要求 6 帧，本条按八帧画。 橙色反光带是他唯一的亮橙色；盾面光环熄灭的那一帧由渲染层压暗光环色样实现，不另出图。

subject.zh: 二十四岁的人族青年学者，高瘦，背微驼。浅棕卷发乱糟糟，下巴有胡茬，细框眼镜的一片镜片有裂纹，灰蓝眼睛总在盯着人看。深蓝贤者长袍 #2a3a6a 里穿灰色高领毛衣 #8a8a90，铜扣点缀，手里一本皮面笔记本与一支圆珠笔。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-four-year-old human scholar, tall, thin and slightly stooped. Messy light brown curls, stubble on his chin, thin-rimmed glasses with one cracked lens, grey-blue eyes that always study people. A deep blue sage's robe #2a3a6a over a grey turtleneck sweater #8a8a90, copper buttons, a leather-bound notebook and a ballpoint pen in hand. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 本条不是施法，八帧按顺序是一段过场动作：第 1、2 帧从怀里掏出皮面笔记本，第 3、4 帧拿出那支细长的笔，按了一下笔头；第 5、6 帧低头在本子上飞快地写，第 7 帧甩了甩写不出水的笔，第 8 帧接着写。
extra.en: This is not a spell: the eight frames form one continuous cutscene action in order: frames 1 and 2 he pulls the leather notebook from his coat, frames 3 and 4 he takes out the slender pen and clicks its top; frames 5 and 6 he bends over the notebook writing fast, frame 7 he shakes the pen that has run dry, frame 8 he keeps writing.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a2_arrest 与 cut_a2_no_page，过场取第 1、3 行（正面与背面）；目录要求 6 帧，本条按八帧画。 裂纹在左边镜片；笔记本上不写字；圆珠笔是这个世界没有的东西，画成一支细长的笔即可。

subject.zh: 五十八岁的人族钟匠，矮壮，手臂粗，脸圆，花白络腮胡，耳朵上罩着护耳的皮罩，眼神专注又温和。灰白短发压在一顶皮帽下，帽檐别着一片放大镜，褐色眼睛。深褐皮工作服 #5a4030 外系帆布围裙，腰插扳手与小锤，肩搭一圈钟绳。
subject.en: A fifty-eight-year-old human bellwright, short and stocky with thick arms, a round face and a grizzled full beard, leather ear guards over his ears, focused, gentle eyes. Grey-white short hair under a leather cap with a magnifying lens clipped to its brim, brown eyes. A dark brown leather work suit #5a4030 with a canvas apron, a wrench and small hammer tucked in his belt, a coil of bell rope over his shoulder.

extra.zh: 本条不是施法，八帧按顺序是一段过场动作：一根粗钟绳从格子上方垂下（只画绳，不画钟）；第 1 到 4 帧双手抓绳，全身吊在绳上，随绳一上一下，双脚离开地面；第 5 帧被绳带到最高，第 6 帧用全身的重量往下拽（钟响的瞬间），第 7、8 帧随绳回荡。
extra.en: This is not a spell: the eight frames form one continuous cutscene action in order: a thick bell rope hangs from the top of the cell (draw only the rope, no bell); frames 1 to 4 he grips the rope with both hands and hangs from it with his whole body, rising and falling with it, feet off the ground; frame 5 the rope carries him to the top, frame 6 he hauls down with all his weight (the moment the bell rings), frames 7 and 8 he swings back with the rope.

items.notes: 附该 NPC 的纸娃娃组装预览图（游戏导出的三向放大图）作参照：他在场景里是纸娃娃组装的人物，没有三视图；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a2_siege 的黎明，过场只用第 1 行（面向镜头）；目录要求南向 8 帧。 与边石镇敲钟人区分：他是工匠，工具与放大镜片是辨识点。

subject.zh: 三十一岁的人族壮汉，高大魁梧，深棕皮肤，剃短的黑发，修剪整齐的胡子，笑起来一口白牙，深褐眼睛，左前臂有烧伤疤。白银重甲 #c8ccd4，腰间系一条褪色的亮橙反光带 #e8782a，左手持正面浮雕光环的塔盾，背包上挂一顶旧消防头盔。Q 版约 1.8 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-one-year-old human giant of a man, tall and broad: deep brown skin, buzzed black hair, a neatly trimmed beard, a bright white smile, dark brown eyes, a burn scar on his left forearm. Silver-white heavy plate #c8ccd4, a faded bright orange reflective band #e8782a tied at his waist, a tower shield embossed with a halo on his left arm, an old firefighter's helmet hanging from his pack. Chibi about 1.8 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 过场专属动作，按顺序播放一次，不必接回第 1 帧：第 1、2 帧把塔盾丢到脚边（盾倒在地上，画进来），第 3、4 帧张开双臂挡在身后的人前面，挺胸站定。
extra.en: Cutscene action, played once in order, with no need to loop back to frame 1: frames 1 and 2 he drops the tower shield at his feet (the shield lying on the ground is drawn), frames 3 and 4 he spreads his arms wide in front of the people behind him and stands firm, chest out.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a3_massacre 与 cut_a3_ashen_line；目录要求四向各 2 帧，左向由右向镜像。 橙色反光带是他唯一的亮橙色；盾面光环熄灭的那一帧由渲染层压暗光环色样实现，不另出图。

subject.zh: 骸骨守门人：人形骨架，眼眶里两点灰蓝冷火。披一件褪成灰白的古朴亚麻长袍 #c8c4b8，额骨上嵌一枚铜绿色的门形铜饰 #5a8a7a，指骨间夹一支芦苇笔，身上落着灰。炭黑、冷蓝、铜绿。安静而压迫。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A skeletal gatekeeper: a human skeleton with two points of cold grey-blue fire in its eye sockets. An antique linen robe faded to ash white #c8c4b8, a verdigris door-shaped copper ornament #5a8a7a set into the brow bone, a reed pen held between finger bones, ash settled on him. Charcoal, cold blue, verdigris. Quiet and oppressive. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 本条不是施法，八帧按顺序是一段过场动作：第 1、2 帧是伏在地上的一副骸骨（倒下的书架不画），第 3、4 帧骨手撑地，慢慢跪起，第 5 帧站起，第 6 帧完全站直（站定的瞬间），第 7、8 帧抖落袍子上的灰，眼眶里的冷火亮起。
extra.en: This is not a spell: the eight frames form one continuous cutscene action in order: frames 1 and 2 are a skeleton lying face down on the floor (no fallen bookshelves drawn), frames 3 and 4 the bony hands push against the floor as it slowly kneels up, frame 5 it rises, frame 6 it stands fully upright (the moment it is standing), frames 7 and 8 it shakes the ash off its robe and the cold fire in its eye sockets lights up.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a3_sundering，过场只用第 1 行（面向镜头）；目录要求 1 向 6 帧，本条按八帧画。 是骸骨，不是活人；身边与袍子上不出现任何字。

subject.zh: 六十岁上下的人族大主教，瘦高挺直，白发剪得很短，神情笃定；穿白底金纹的主教长袍，头戴高主教冠（#f2efe6、#c9a646），胸前垂着金色光环纹的圣带，双手握着一柄顶端是光环的金色长权杖。
subject.en: A human archbishop of about sixty, tall, thin and upright, white hair cut very short, a certain and settled expression; a white archbishop robe with gold patterns and a tall miter (#f2efe6, #c9a646), a gold halo-patterned stole down his chest, a long gold crozier topped with a halo held in both hands.

extra.zh: 本条不是施法，八帧按顺序是一段过场动作：第 1 到 4 帧双手握着光环长权杖抵在身前，低头默祷，身体微微起伏；第 5 帧双臂把权杖向上托起，第 6 帧权杖高举过头顶（举到最高的瞬间），第 7、8 帧保持高举，仰头望天。
extra.en: This is not a spell: the eight frames form one continuous cutscene action in order: frames 1 to 4 he holds the long halo crozier upright before him in both hands, head bowed in silent prayer, body rising and falling slightly; frame 5 his arms lift the crozier upward, frame 6 it is raised high above his head (the moment it reaches the top), frames 7 and 8 he holds it aloft, face turned to the sky.

items.notes: 附大主教的首领三视图 art_boss_archbishop_dawnpillar_ref 作参照（他在场景里用首领立牌）；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a3_ashen_line，过场只用第 1 行（面向镜头）；目录要求 1 向 6 帧，本条按八帧画。曙光圣柱是另一件物件，由特效 art_vfx_cut_dawnpillar 另画，不画进本条。

subject.zh: 三十二岁的人族女拳手将军，高挑精壮，深红短发向后梳，左眉一道疤把眉毛断开，深褐眼睛带着战意，下颌左侧挂一枚染红的魔物獠牙耳坠。黑红轻甲 #1e1a1a、#8a1c22，不戴头盔，双手缠拳击绷带，戴一对铁拳套 #6a6a70。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-two-year-old human woman boxer general, tall and hard-muscled: dark red short hair swept back, a scar that splits her left eyebrow, dark brown eyes full of fight, a blood-red monster fang earring hanging at the left of her jaw. Black and red light armor #1e1a1a, #8a1c22, no helmet, boxing wraps on both hands under a pair of iron fist gauntlets #6a6a70. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 过场专属的一掷：第 1 帧弯腰抱起一块磨盘大的圆石，第 2 帧把石头举过头顶，第 3 帧身体后仰蓄力，第 4 帧把石头掷出（出手的瞬间，石头刚离手），第 5 帧余势前冲，第 6 帧收势站稳。
extra.en: The cutscene's throw: frame 1 she bends and hoists a round boulder the size of a millstone, frame 2 she lifts it over her head, frame 3 she leans back to gather force, frame 4 she hurls it (the moment of release, the stone just leaving her hands), frame 5 she follows through forward, frame 6 she recovers and stands firm.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a3_ashen_line，过场只用第 1 行（面向镜头）；飞出去的石头由道具与特效另做，第 5、6 帧手里不再有石头。 眉疤在左眉，獠牙耳坠在左侧；她不用兵器，只用拳。

subject.zh: 二十四岁的人族青年，中等身材偏瘦长，习惯缩着肩。棕色乱发，满脸雀斑，褐色眼睛，神情紧张又可靠。不太合身的二手皮甲 #6a5a44，脖子上一条褪色的蓝毛线围巾 #5a7a9a，左臂缠满五色护符，左手一面坑坑洼洼的旧铁圆盾，腰挂铜牌与短剑。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A twenty-four-year-old human young man, medium build on the lanky side, shoulders habitually hunched. Messy brown hair, a face full of freckles, brown eyes, nervous yet dependable. Ill-fitting second-hand leather armor #6a5a44, a faded blue knitted scarf #5a7a9a around his neck, his left arm wrapped in charms of five colors, a dented old iron round shield on his left arm, a copper tag and a short sword at his belt. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 本条不是施法，八帧按顺序是一段过场动作：一根插在泥里的旗杆，旗面是一块深色粗布；第 1 到 4 帧弯腰双手握住旗杆，用力往外拔；第 5 帧旗杆拔出、向上抡起，第 6 帧旗举过头顶（举到最高的瞬间），旗面在风里展开，第 7、8 帧举旗站定，围巾被风扯起。
extra.en: This is not a spell: the eight frames form one continuous cutscene action in order: a flagpole stuck in the mud with a dark rough cloth banner; frames 1 to 4 he bends and grips the pole with both hands, straining to pull it out; frame 5 the pole comes free and swings upward, frame 6 the flag is raised above his head (the moment it reaches the top) as the banner unfurls in the wind, frames 7 and 8 he stands holding the flag, his scarf tugged by the wind.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a3_domain，过场只用第 1 行（面向镜头）；目录要求 1 向 6 帧，本条按八帧画。旧圆盾仍挂在左臂；旗面不画任何纹章与文字。 围巾是褪色的蓝，不要画成鲜蓝；盾与护符都在左臂。

subject.zh: 五十八岁的人族皇帝，高大魁伟，铁灰短发与短须，灰色眼睛沉稳，左手小指缺了半截。朴素的黑铁战甲 #2e2e30，披帝国紫披风 #5a2a6a，银色铆钉，腰佩一把毫无装饰的长剑，剑柄上随手挂着帝冠。Q 版约 1.8 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A fifty-eight-year-old human emperor, tall and massive: iron-grey short hair and short beard, steady grey eyes, the left little finger missing its upper half. Plain black iron battle armor #2e2e30 with silver rivets under an imperial purple cape #5a2a6a, a completely unadorned longsword at his hip with the imperial crown hung carelessly on its hilt. Chibi about 1.8 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 本条不是施法，八帧按顺序是一段过场动作：第 1 到 4 帧极慢地拔剑，剑一寸一寸出鞘，挂在剑柄上的帝冠随之晃动；第 5 帧双手举剑，第 6 帧一剑劈落（落剑的瞬间），第 7 帧剑势停在下方，第 8 帧缓缓收剑。
extra.en: This is not a spell: the eight frames form one continuous cutscene action in order: frames 1 to 4 he draws the sword extremely slowly, inch by inch, the crown hanging from the hilt swaying as it comes; frame 5 he raises the sword in both hands, frame 6 a single cut falls (the moment of the strike), frame 7 the blade stops low, frame 8 he slowly sheathes it.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a4_feast（强者之宴），过场取第 1、2 行（正面与侧面）；剑光由特效另画。 缺的是左手小指的上半截；帝冠挂在剑柄上，不戴在头上。

subject.zh: 被割了舌头的遗民敲钟人，瘦高，三十来岁，灰褐的旧斗篷打满补丁，围巾裹住下半张脸，左手套边露出一块拱门形的胎记；腰间挂着一口青铜手钟，右手握着敲钟的短锤，胸前用皮绳挂着一把没有纹样的古旧钥匙。
subject.en: A tongueless bell ringer of the remnant folk, tall and thin, about thirty, a patched gray-brown old cloak, a scarf wrapped over the lower half of his face, an arch-shaped birthmark peeking out from the edge of his left glove; a bronze hand bell at his waist, a short striking hammer in his right hand, an old key with no markings hung on a leather cord at his chest.

extra.zh: 过场专属动作，按顺序播放一次，不必接回第 1 帧：第 1 帧站着，双手捧着一枚刚取下的钥匙，第 2 帧单膝跪下，第 3 帧双膝跪地，第 4 帧俯身，以额头轻触捧在手里的钥匙。
extra.en: Cutscene action, played once in order, with no need to loop back to frame 1: frame 1 he stands holding a key he has just taken in both hands, frame 2 he drops to one knee, frame 3 to both knees, frame 4 he bows forward and touches his forehead lightly to the key in his hands.

items.notes: 附哑钟的首领三视图 art_boss_mute_bell_chase_ref 作参照（他在场景里用首领立牌）；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a4_key_theft 段一，过场只用第 1 行（面向镜头）。钥匙不画纹样与文字。

subject.zh: 修长消瘦的人形，裹在层层黑灰旧斗篷里 #2a2a2e，斗篷下摆像墨一样往下滴着暗紫的澱 #4a3a62。脸是一片光滑空白的平面，像没写字的纸，正中一道细细的门形裂缝，透出暗紫微光。双手缠着灰白绷带，腰间挂一串拓着门形纹的纸片。Q 版约 1.7 头身。
subject.en: A tall, gaunt human figure wrapped in layers of old charcoal cloaks #2a2a2e, the hem dripping dark purple sediment like ink #4a3a62. The face is a smooth blank plane like an unwritten page, with a thin door-shaped crack down the middle leaking a dim purple glow. Hands wrapped in grey-white bandages, a string of paper rubbings of door shapes at the waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall.

extra.zh: 本条不是施法，八帧按顺序是一段过场动作：第 1、2 帧站定，头微微低着；第 3、4 帧缓缓回过头来，空白的脸望向身后，第 5 帧停住；第 6 帧转过身去（转身的瞬间），第 7、8 帧迈步走开。
extra.en: This is not a spell: the eight frames form one continuous cutscene action in order: frames 1 and 2 he stands still with his head slightly bowed; frames 3 and 4 he slowly looks back over his shoulder with the blank face, frame 5 he holds; frame 6 he turns away (the moment of turning), frames 7 and 8 he walks off.

items.notes: 附本人三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头；辨识特征按固定描述块，一字不改。 用于 cut_a4_key_theft 段三；没入灰中的淡出由渲染层做。目录要求 6 帧，本条按八帧画。 脸上绝对不画五官；手背的门纹由渲染层画，不进素材；对话框只显示空的头像框，头像与半身立绘只用于角色卡与过场演出；纸片上没有字。

subject.zh: 年迈的老人，瘦小而硬朗，脸上皱纹密布，笑起来缺了两颗牙，眼神明亮温和。稀疏白发垂到肩头，白胡子编成一条细辫，浅褐眼睛。洗得发白的灰褐长袍 #7a7060，肩上搭一条手织的彩纹围巾，手里拿一支旧木笛。
subject.en: An elderly man, small but hale, a face covered in fine wrinkles, a smile missing two teeth, bright gentle eyes. Thin white hair to his shoulders, a white beard in one thin braid, light brown eyes. A washed-out grey-brown long robe #7a7060, a hand-woven striped scarf over his shoulders, an old wooden flute in his hand.

extra.zh: 过场专属动作，按顺序播放一次，不必接回第 1 帧：第 1 帧弯腰，用手拂掉石座上的霜（石座不画），第 2 帧直起身、转过身来，第 3 帧慢慢坐下，悬空坐姿，第 4 帧坐定，把木笛横放在膝上。
extra.en: Cutscene action, played once in order, with no need to loop back to frame 1: frame 1 he bends and brushes the frost off a stone seat with his hand (no seat drawn), frame 2 he straightens and turns around, frame 3 he slowly sits in a seated pose in the air, frame 4 he settles and lays the wooden flute across his knees.

subject.zh: 修长消瘦的人形，裹在层层黑灰旧斗篷里 #2a2a2e，斗篷下摆像墨一样往下滴着暗紫的澱 #4a3a62。脸是一片光滑空白的平面，像没写字的纸，正中一道细细的门形裂缝，透出暗紫微光。双手缠着灰白绷带，腰间挂一串拓着门形纹的纸片。Q 版约 1.7 头身。
subject.en: A tall, gaunt human figure wrapped in layers of old charcoal cloaks #2a2a2e, the hem dripping dark purple sediment like ink #4a3a62. The face is a smooth blank plane like an unwritten page, with a thin door-shaped crack down the middle leaking a dim purple glow. Hands wrapped in grey-white bandages, a string of paper rubbings of door shapes at the waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall.

extra.zh: 过场专属姿势，4 帧循环：斜靠在一副门框上（门框是场景道具，不画进来；身体向一侧倾斜约十五度，像靠在看不见的框上），双手抱在胸前，空白的脸朝向前方；四帧之间只有斗篷下摆滴澱与门形裂缝光的细小变化。
extra.en: Cutscene pose, a 4-frame loop: leaning against a door frame (the frame is a scene prop and is not drawn; the body tilts about fifteen degrees to one side as if resting on an unseen frame), arms folded across the chest, the blank face turned forward; the four frames differ only in the sediment dripping from the cloak hem and the light of the door-shaped crack.

subject.en: A gaunt man in his thirties with an ordinary, tired face, shadowed eye sockets, quiet eyes and messy short black hair. Hands wrapped in worn grey-white bandages, a string of paper rubbings of door shapes still at his waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall.

extra.zh: 第 4 格胸像画清那张普通而疲惫的脸。
extra.en: The bust in panel 4 clearly shows the ordinary, tired face.
